title: Functions and graphs
introduction: Reconnect graphs, formulas, and models through five substantial lessons. Start with a diagnostic, recover a particular skill, or rebuild the full chain from coordinates to calibration. Refresher evidence stays separate from university course completion.

lessons.title: Coordinates, scales, and lines
lessons.objective: Read scaled coordinates, find signed slopes with units, distinguish zero and undefined slope, and interpret intercepts.

lessons.title: Function inputs, domains, and piecewise rules
lessons.objective: Classify a function, evaluate complete inputs, preserve its domain, and read finite and piecewise ranges without inventing outputs.

lessons.title: Transformations and graph features
lessons.objective: Map points through shifts, scales, and reflections; transform domains and ranges; distinguish intercepts, monotonic intervals, and local versus absolute extrema.

lessons.title: Composition and inverse functions
lessons.objective: Compose in the stated order with both domain checks, restrict inverse branches when necessary, and verify both inverse identities.

lessons.title: Average rates and linear calibration
lessons.objective: Calculate interval average rates, fit and interpret a linear model, recover an input when valid, and assess residuals and prediction scope.
